parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. If this parameter is empty, no more pages are available

parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The product capability to which the resource belongs. Valid values:
HBR: Cloud Backup standard capability.
BASIC: ECS File Backup Essential Edition
parameters.help_zh:
所属产品能力，支持：
HBR：云备份标准能力。
BASIC：ECS文件备份基础版
parameters.name: created_by_product

parameters.help_en:
The backup feature type. Valid values:
ECS_FILE: ECS file backup.
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) backup.
COMMON_NAS: on-premises NAS backup.
File: on-premises file backup.
NAS: Alibaba Cloud NAS backup.
OSS: OSS backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份功能类型，支持：
ECS_FILE：ECS文件备份。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：CPFS备份。
COMMON_NAS：本地NAS备份。
File：本地文件备份。
NAS：阿里云NAS备份。
OSS：OSS备份
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.
SourceType=ECS_FILE: the ECS instance ID.
SourceType=COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: the CPFS data source ID.
SourceType=COMMON_NAS: the on-premises NAS data source ID.
SourceType=File: the local service client ID.
SourceType=NAS: the Alibaba Cloud NAS file system ID.
SourceType=OSS: the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。
SourceType=ECS_FILE：表示ECS实例ID。
SourceType=COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：表示CPFS数据源ID。
SourceType=COMMON_NAS：表示本地NAS数据源ID。
SourceType=File：表示本地服务器客户端ID。

SourceType=OSS：表示OSS Bucket
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to skip for paging.
If the number of skipped entries exceeds the total number of conditional entries, an empty list is returned. The number of skipped entries must be a multiple of MaxResults
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时跳过的条目数。
当跳过的条目数超过符合条件的条目总数时，会返回空列表。跳过的条目数需要是MaxResults的倍数
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the resource has backup points
parameters.name: has_snapshot
